$description: Golem elevation. Three composite shadows, each built from three drop shadows. All shadow colours are zeroed in dark mode — in dark UI, hierarchy comes from surface and border, never from a shadow.

golem.source: Figma composite effect variables '✅ shadow/✅ panel' and '✅ shadow/✅ floating' read from CO Content Card, CO InLine Message, CO Snackbar and CO Segmented Control nodes 2026-08-12; 'highlighted' colours from the Golem showcase snapshot 2026-08-11, composite geometry assumed identical to panel
golem.note: Figma names the blur tokens by percentage of a 100 scale: blur/10 = 1px, blur/25 = 2px, blur/100 = 8px; offset/5 = 0.4px, offset/10 = 1px.

panel.$description: Cards, panels, inline messages. The default raised surface.

floating.$description: Floating toolbar, snackbar, segmented control thumb — anything that sits above scrolling content.

highlighted.$description: Highlighted card. Colours verified; the offsets and blurs are assumed to match panel and are the one unverified value in this file.
